div.class: products_header btn-toolbar flex-nowrap align-items-center justify-content-between gap-3 mb-3

a.t-att-href: category.parent_id and keep('/shop/category/' + slug(category.parent_id), category=0) or '/shop'

button.t-if: is_view_active('website_sale.sort') or opt_wsale_categories or opt_wsale_attributes or opt_wsale_attributes_top

span.t-attf-class: position-absolute top-0 start-100 translate-middle border border-{{navClass}} rounded-circle bg-danger p-1

xpath.attribute: (not rating_valid_ids or product.id in rating_valid_ids) and product.qty_available > 0

input.name: csrf_token
input.t-nocache: The csrf token must always be up to date.

span.class: oe_product_image_img_wrapper d-flex h-100 justify-content-center align-items-center position-absolute

div.class: o_wsale_product_information position-relative d-flex flex-column flex-grow-1 flex-shrink-1
o_wsale_product_sub d-flex justify-content-between align-items-end gap-2 flex-wrap pb-1

button.class: btn btn-primary js_check_product a-submit buy-now js_add_to_cart

input.name: rating
input.t-att-checked: 'checked' if int(current_min_rating or 0) == star else None

i.t-attf-class: fa fa-star#{' text-warning' if i < star else ' text-muted-star'}

input.name: rating_responsive
input.t-att-checked: 'checked' if int(current_min_rating or 0) == star else None

i.t-attf-class: fa fa-star#{' text-warning' if i < star else ' text-muted-star'}

button.class: btn btn-primary js_check_product a-submit buy-now js_add_to_cart

div.p: Este producto no se encuentra en consignación en estos momentos, usted debe hacer una solicitud de importación. Si desea continuar con el proceso, presiona Aceptar, si no presione Cancelar.
